questions.question: What is the main purpose of reading comprehension exercises?
options: To understand text meaning and develop critical thinking
questions.answer: To understand text meaning and develop critical thinking
questions.explanation: Reading comprehension develops understanding and critical analysis skills.

questions.question: Skimming a text means reading it slowly and carefully.
questions.explanation: Skimming means reading quickly to get the general idea, not in detail.

questions.question: The ___ of a text is the central message the author wants to convey.
questions.explanation: The theme is the central message or main idea of a text.

questions.question: Name two reading strategies you can use to understand a difficult text.
questions.answer: Context clues to infer meaning of unknown words; re-reading difficult passages; using prior knowledge.
questions.explanation: Good readers use strategies to comprehend difficult texts.
